label: seasonal-naive+holt-damped baseline v1.0.0
honestyStatement: This is a statistical BASELINE model, not a machine-learned model. Every forecast response carries modelDisclaimer restating this. It must never be presented to users as an AI/ML prediction.

algorithm.summary: Multiplicative seasonal decomposition (seasonal indices vs centred moving average) + damped Holt linear exponential smoothing (alpha=0.4, beta=0.1, phi=0.9) on the deseasonalized series; seasonal-naive fallback when fewer than 2 full seasons are recorded; non-seasonal naive fallback below that.
algorithm.predictionIntervals: 80% and 95% Gaussian intervals from 1-step in-sample residual std, widened by sqrt(horizon)
algorithm.failClosed: INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY (HTTP 409) when fewer than 8 recorded observations exist; forecasts are never synthesized

trainingData.source: port_queue_observations (migration 0013) — queue-length projections of recorded eCallUp / gate events
trainingData.provenance: every observation row carries port_code, source and observed_at; no synthetic rows

evaluation.method: expanding-origin 1-step backtest over the trailing 25% (max 48 points) of the recorded series, seasonal-naive reference
evaluation.reportedIn: forecast response fields backtestMAE / backtestMAPE (per-request, computed on the actual recorded series)
evaluation.unitTestThreshold: MAPE < 15% on the recorded-shape seasonal fixture (internal/congestion/forecast_test.go)

limitations: assumes queue dynamics are seasonal + slowly trending; cannot anticipate strikes, weather closures or berth breakdowns
hourly step assumed; irregular observations are treated as equally spaced
